title: Consolidated Roadmap Snapshot + 30/60/90 Risk Lanes for Exec Readout
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Purpose: Produce a compact, exec-grade packet that shows the consolidated product roadmap across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private lines with explicit 30/60/90 day milestones, confidence bands (Green/Amber/Red), quantified upside/downside on inference unit economics, and clear ask lanes for exec decisions.

Scope:
- One-pager snapshot (top-level metrics and asks) for board/QBR.
- 3-page appendix: detailed milestone list by team (Eng, RD, Console, Ops), routing of major dependencies, and contingency playbook for each high-risk milestone.
- Scenario lanes (best/likely/worst) with staffing and cost delta for each scenario.

Deliverables:
1) Exec one-pager PDF (for slide deck).
2) Detailed spreadsheet with milestone-level status, owners, and risk drivers.
3) Internal playbook (Confluence) for follow-ups and escalation lanes.

Key success criteria:
- Deck is under 4 slides and readable in 3 minutes.
- All P0 milestones have a named owner and mitigation plan.
- Asks are grouped into funding/headcount/approval and mapped to fiscal impact (monthly burn and run rate after ship).

Stakeholders: PM (Asha), Eng Lead (Daniel K.), Design (Maya Ortiz), Reliability (Samir Rao), Finance (Lena Moretti).

Artifact links:
- Draft deck: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/roadmap-Q2-2026
- Milestone tracker: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/roadmap-30-60-90
- Confluence playbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PM/pages/roadmap-playbook
